searchText: One aspect is we can re-use header parsing code if all headers are of the form <header> <uint16> for single value headers and <header> <len:uint16> <uint16>*len. Adding Uint8 reduces a lot of code reuse.

excerpts.content: One aspect is we can re-use header parsing code if all headers are of the form <header> <uint16> for single value headers and <header> <len:uint16> <uint16>*len.  Adding Uint8 reduces a lot of code reuse.
